title: Terms of Service
intro: Welcome to the website of Ebbatech Nigeria Limited. By submitting an enquiry, requesting a quotation, or otherwise using this site, you agree to be bound by the following terms.

sections.heading: Quotations & Proposals
sections.body: Quotations, consultations, and facility recommendations provided by Ebbatech are estimates based on the information you supply and are subject to confirmation following a site review where applicable.

sections.heading: Installation & Relocation Services
sections.body: Where Ebbatech provides installation, relocation or reconfiguration services, the scope of work, timelines and costs will be agreed with the client in writing prior to commencement.

sections.heading: Site Access
sections.body: During site surveys and installations, client facilities must provide safe access for our teams. Ebbatech personnel comply with standard occupational health and safety practices while on site.
